name: Container VS Bin Stock Balance
query:
SELECT 
    b.item_code AS item_code, 
    b.warehouse AS warehouse,
    b.actual_qty AS bin_qty,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.name) AS containers,
    ((SUM(c.primary_available_qty) + SUM(IFNULL(sd.reserved_qty, 0)))) AS total_container_qty_avail,
    SUM(c.primary_available_qty) AS primary_available_qty,
    (((SUM(c.primary_available_qty) + SUM(IFNULL(sd.reserved_qty, 0)))) - b.actual_qty) as qty_diff,
    SUM(IFNULL(sd.reserved_qty, 0)) AS container_reserved_qty, 
    MAX(c.modified) AS last_container_update_date
FROM 
    `tabBin` b
JOIN 
    `tabContainer` c 
    ON c.item_code = b.item_code 
    AND c.warehouse = b.warehouse
    AND c.status != "Inactive"
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT parent, SUM(reserved_qty) AS reserved_qty
    FROM `tabStock Details`
    GROUP BY parent
) sd ON sd.parent = c.name
GROUP BY 
    b.item_code, b.warehouse, b.actual_qty
HAVING 
    bin_qty != total_container_qty_avail
    and (total_container_qty_avail-bin_qty) between -1 and 1;
